description:
Sweep workers reported tests that assert less than their names state and measured figures hard-coded in code without provenance.

## Background

Tests: `crates/gf2-coding/tests/ldpc_simd_validation.rs` `test_simd_vs_scalar_consistency` (never compares scalar with SIMD); `tests/ldpc_validation.rs` `test_syndrome_linearity`, `test_codeword_closure_under_xor` (two zero words); `tests/test_vector_parser.rs:16` (empty test); `tests/uncoded_ber_baseline.rs` (unseeded RNG; the message at line 65 quotes a wrong BER); `tests/modem_reference_model.rs` (`axis4_non_gray_spec` labels are Gray); `examples/ldpc_bler_check.rs` (`decoder_bp` is plain min-sum); `crates/gf2-coding/src/simulation.rs` (`prop_ber_between_zero_and_one`, `prop_bler_between_zero_and_one`, the `matches_legacy_bpsk` property); `crates/gf2-sim/tests/campaign_cli_flags.rs` `cli_resume_byte_identical_to_uninterrupted` (SIGINT after a fixed sleep, exit status ignored); `crates/gf2-sim/tests/checkpoint_compat.rs` (empty non-unix `send_sigint`). Constants: `ATTESTED_MBPS` in `crates/gf2-sim/benches/`, baseline fps constants in the throughput binaries, `MEASURED_WORST_ABS_DIFF` in `tests/gpu_demap_byte_identity.rs:25` (`@/inv/runtime-observed-provenance`). Path: `crates/gf2-sim/tests/osd_campaign_protocol.rs` near line 781 hard-codes `../../dev/simulation_results/...` (`@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed test asserts the property its name states, or is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each measured constant cites its committed receipt by identity or is removed.
- [hard] REQ-03: The hard-coded `dev/` path resolves through the configured repository root or content identity.
title: Weak tests and unattributed measured constants in gf2-coding and gf2-sim targets
